cases.title: Retain the first live extraction support-gate incident

origin.reference: Private historical validation evidence is omitted; this suite retains synthetic regression inputs.

cases.rationale: The unchanged historical draft includes untested general character/case-folding behavior beyond the local observations, so it should not enter human review as fully evidence-supported. The original Jev answer was supported at probability 0.74, below the 0.8 policy threshold; that was abstention, not an unsupported choice. This new live case tests eligibility again without asserting a stable future score.

draft.title: Go: collapse Unicode whitespace in a normalizer with strings.Fields + Join instead of TrimSpace
draft.summary: In a small Go fixture, NormalizeOwner used strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw)), which only trims the ends. The test failed because internal tabs, repeated spaces, and NBSP (U+00A0) were kept. The function was changed to strings.ToLower(strings.Join(strings.Fields(raw), " ")). After that edit, `go test ./... -count=1` reported ok on two later runs. The evidence covers only the three cases in the test suite: ASCII tab/newline/space runs, em space plus NBSP runs, and an all-whitespace input.
draft.conditions: Applies to a Go string normalizer that must lowercase input and collapse every run of whitespace, Unicode whitespace included, into one ASCII space with no leading or trailing spaces. It also applies when the current code uses strings.TrimSpace and tests fail on internal whitespace. The demonstration is limited to the three cases in owner_test.go. It does not show how characters that unicode.IsSpace does not treat as whitespace are handled (for example U+200B), and it does not show full Unicode case folding.
steps: Read the implementation and its test file to find the current normalization expression and the expected outputs (here: owner.go and owner_test.go).
Run `go test ./... -count=1` before editing and note which cases fail and the actual vs. wanted values. In the observed run, the outputs kept "\t  " and "  " inside the string.

Replace `strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw))` with `strings.ToLower(strings.Join(strings.Fields(raw), " "))`. strings.Fields splits on runs of whitespace and drops leading and trailing runs. Edit only the implementation file and leave the tests and go.mod alone.
Run `go test ./... -count=1` again, making sure the call is issued after the edit result has come back, and check that it reports ok.
Report the limits: a passing run covers only the existing test cases. Characters that unicode.IsSpace does not treat as whitespace are kept, and strings.ToLower does not do full case folding.
